name: dialog
title: Dialog
description: A modal dialog on Base UI's Dialog: a trigger, a scrim, a centred popup in four widths with a title, a description, a scrolling body, a footer of actions and a close button.

manifest.name: dialog
manifest.title: Dialog
manifest.description: A modal dialog on Base UI's Dialog: a trigger, a scrim, a centred popup in four widths with a title, a description, a scrolling body, a footer of actions and a close button.
manifest.usage: Use Dialog for a short task the user must finish or cancel before going on, on top of the page: export settings, rename, keyboard shortcuts, About. Compose it as Dialog > DialogTrigger (render a Button) + DialogContent > DialogHeader (DialogTitle, DialogDescription), DialogBody, DialogFooter (DialogClose rendering a Button, then the primary action last). Every dialog needs a DialogTitle; open it without a trigger through open and onOpenChange (from a menu item or a shortcut). For a decision that must not be dismissed by a click outside (delete, destructive SQL, approve access) use AlertDialog; for a form that edits something beside the page (a connection) use Sheet; for a small, non-modal panel attached to a control use Popover.

props.name: size
props.description: The popup's maximum width, from size.panel.* (320, 448, 576, 768 px); it shrinks on narrow viewports.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; defaultOpen when uncontrolled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the trigger, a DialogClose, Escape or a click on the scrim opens or closes it.

props.name: modal
props.description: As Base UI: true traps focus, locks scroll and blocks the page.

props.name: disablePointerDismissal
props.description: Keeps the dialog open on a click outside it.

props.name: showClose
props.description: DialogContent: shows the close button in the top corner.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: DialogContent: the accessible name of the close button.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: DialogContent: the element focused on open (default: the first focusable element).

props.name: finalFocus
props.description: DialogContent: the element focused on close (default: the trigger).

props.name: className
props.description: On each part: extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: backdrop
slots.description: The scrim, color.bg.scrim at z.overlay; data-slot="dialog-backdrop".

slots.name: viewport
slots.description: A fixed layer at z.modal that centres and scrolls the popup, with the trigger region's data-theme and data-density; data-slot="dialog-viewport".

slots.name: popup
slots.description: role="dialog", color.bg.overlay with elevation.modal; data-slot="dialog-content", data-size.

parts.name: DialogTrigger
parts.description: Opens the dialog; unstyled, render a Button through render. aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded.

parts.name: DialogContent
parts.description: The portal with the scrim, the viewport and the popup, plus a close IconButton unless showClose is false.

parts.name: DialogViewport
parts.description: The centring layer; DialogContent renders it.

parts.name: DialogHeader
parts.description: The title and description, stacked, leaving room for the close button.

parts.name: DialogTitle
parts.description: An <h2> in type.heading-4 that names the dialog (aria-labelledby).

parts.name: DialogDescription
parts.description:
A

in color.fg.muted that describes the dialog (aria-describedby).

parts.name: DialogBody
parts.description: The content between header and footer; scrolls when the dialog is taller than the viewport.

parts.name: DialogFooter
parts.description: The actions at the end of the row, the primary action last.

parts.name: DialogClose
parts.description: Closes the dialog; unstyled, render a Button through render.

states.name: open
states.description: Opening: the popup grows from 95 % and fades in over motion.duration.slow with motion.easing.emphasized, the scrim fades in; reduced motion turns the transitions off.

accessibility: The popup is role="dialog", named by DialogTitle (aria-labelledby) and described by DialogDescription (aria-describedby); every dialog has a title. While it is open the rest of the page is hidden from assistive technology and inert (Base UI marks it, rather than setting aria-modal).
Opening moves focus into the popup (the first focusable element, or initialFocus); Tab and Shift+Tab stay inside; closing returns focus to the trigger (or finalFocus).
Escape closes the dialog, and so does a press on the scrim unless disablePointerDismissal is set; the page behind does not scroll and ignores the pointer while it is open.
The close button is an IconButton with an accessible name (closeLabel, "Close" by default) and a visible focus ring.
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce turns the scale and fade transitions off (motion-reduce:transition-none).
The popup takes the theme and density of the region it is declared in, not only of <html>, so its contrast matches the page that opened it.
